basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old digital artist from Tilburg, Netherlands, I'm deeply fascinated by the blend of technology and creativity. I spend my evenings exploring the pixelated worlds of Minecraft Dungeons and other RPGs. Although my day job revolves around graphic design, I find solace in the vibrant colors of anime and the imaginative realms of Isekai. Single and enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my interests, I often find myself online during late-night hours, especially after midnight when inspiration strikes. Weekends are for indulging in new hobbies, while weekdays are split between work and digital adventures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Graphic Design and a passion for gaming, I've cultivated a niche knowledge in game graphics and design. My expertise comes from years of self-teaching and experimenting with different digital art tools, coupled with countless hours spent in gaming communities discussing game mechanics and strategies.
